abilities.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Break Them Upon the Walls
abilities.effect: While this unit is **under orders**, the melee weapons of other visible friendly **^^Sigmarite^^** units, excluding **Freeguild Gallants** units, have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Incandescent Incineration
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the target was not **incandescent** when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is **incandescent** for the rest of the battle.
If the target was **incandescent** when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
• Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• The target is no longer **incandescent**.

abilities.name: The Flames of Aqshy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the 'Incandescent Incineration' ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

units.name: Jorvan Kreel, Heir of the Kraken

abilities.name: Harrying Attacks
abilities.effect: While this unit's **Thexa** is next to an enemy unit, that enemy unit's attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Prowling Ash Panther
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: This unit's **Thexa** is a token. If this unit's **Thexa** is not on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place this unit's **Thexa** next to the target, then roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed while this unit's **Thexa** is next to it, remove this unit's **Thexa** from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Fluid Combat Style
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit or a non-**^^Hero Sigmarite Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effect: Immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by that unit has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and more than 3" from all units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features. Remove the unit that used the **^^Fight^^** ability from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of that point and not in combat.

abilities.name: Cinders and Ashes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit contains a **Cindergout**, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Seize the Souls
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit contains a **Soul Shepherd**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot be healed or have slain models returned to it until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Field Surgery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat and contains a **War Surgeon**, pick a visible friendly non-**^^War Machine Sigmarite^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, 
If the target is a non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** unit, return D3 slain models to it. 
If the target is a non-**^^Hero Cavalry^^** unit, return 1 slain model to it. 
If the target is a **^^Hero^^** or **^^Monster^^**, **Heal (D3)** the target.

abilities.name: Lurking Spymaster
abilities.effect:
This unit cannot use or be picked as the target of the 'Form Up!' ability.
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **^^Sigmarite Infantry^^** unit that has 3 or more models and there are no other friendly **Whisperblades** within that unit's combat range, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of shooting attacks or combat attacks.

abilities.name: Deathly Candlelight
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ominous Presence
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the 'Deathly Candlelight' ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Full Charge!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.
**1 *Breaching Assist!*:** If this unit uses the 'Sally Forth' ability this turn, melee weapons used by the targets of that ability have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.
**2 *Full Throttle*:** For the rest of the turn, this unit's Move characteristic is 10".
**3 *Repel Boarders!*:** For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Leadshotters** and **Crushing Iron Feet**.
**4 *Disengage Safeties!*:** For the rest of the turn, the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.
**6 *Get Us Out of Here!*:** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit's 'Full Power!' ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit's **heat tokens**.

abilities.name: All Aboard!
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **^^Sigmarite Infantry Hero^^** and up to 1 friendly non-**^^Hero Sigmarite Infantry^^** unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit's **passengers**. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Sally Forth
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has not used a **^^Run^^** ability this turn, pick this unit's **passengers** to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within 1/2" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Full Power!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.
**1 *Launch Countermeasures!*:** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly **^^Sigmarite^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are **under orders**.
**2 *Full Throttle*:** For the rest of the turn, this unit's Move characteristic is 10".
**3 *Calculate Firing Solution!*:** For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit's **Godbreaker Cannon**.
**6 *Get Us Out of Here!*:** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit's 'Full Power!' ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit's **heat tokens**.

abilities.name: Special Ammunition
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects.
***Nullshot*:** Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit's **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.
***Heavy Shot*:** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.
***Grapeshot*:** After that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolve, if all of the attacks made with this unit's **Godbreaker Cannon** targeted the same enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within that enemy unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Lantern of All-Knowledge
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is wholly within 9" of a corner of the battlefield, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
***Searing Brilliance*:** Friendly **^^Sigmarite^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 6" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit.
***Lambent Aura*:** Add 1 to this unit's power level.
***Luminous Authority*:** Add 2 to arcane manipulation rolls for this unit.
***Prismatic Diffusion*:** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Rod of Radiance** and set its Damage characteristic to 3.

abilities.name: Realmsphere Mastery
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Manifestation^^** within 12" of this unit and that was not set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's banishment value, set up an **^^Endless Spell^^** that can be summoned using a **^^Summon^^** spell that this unit can cast within 1" of the target and more than 3" from all enemy units and other enemy **^^Manifestations^^**. If that **^^Endless Spell^^** has multiple parts, both parts must be set up within 1" of the target. This unit has summoned that **^^Endless Spell^^**. If there is already a friendly **^^Endless Spell^^** of the same type on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play before being set up as described above. Then, the target is banished and removed from play.'

abilities.name: The Four Corners of the Realms
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of a corner of the battlefield and more than 3" from all enemy units.

units.name: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel (Scourge of Aqshy)

abilities.name: Sigmar's Blessing
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Sigmarite^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target's melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.
• If the chanting roll was 10+, the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Unquenchable Faith
abilities.effect:
If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, this unit can immediately use the 'Sigmar's Blessing' ability as if it were your hero phase. If it does so:
• That prayer does not count towards the number of **^^Prayer^^** abilities this unit can use this phase.
• Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, you must use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified.
• The effect of that prayer applies for the rest of the battle instead of until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Crucible of Rage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Form Up
abilities.timing: Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar ^^** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.
**Designer's Note:** *'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal' or 'Cannonade Cogfort'.*

abilities.name: Take Aim
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of that unit's ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Sound the Attack
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a unit that is **under orders**
abilities.effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.

abilities.name: Into Them, You Dogs!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hero^^** that is **under orders** to use this ability. That unit is the **field officer** for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-**^^Hero^^** units that are **under orders** and wholly within 12" of the **field officer** to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the **field officer** uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, you can pick a target that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn. That target is **inspirited** and the other target is **emboldened**.The **inspirited** target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by the **field officer** has been resolved. Then, if the **emboldened** target has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **inspirited** target's **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Hurl Them Back!
abilities.timing: One Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: The Last Blade of Embergard
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon's Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Bones of Saint Ignifus
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** or **^^Prayer^^** ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.

abilities.name: The Sphere Celestial
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** or ^^**Cavalry Hero^^** that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use **^^Move^^** abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).

abilities.name: To the Last
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly unit that is **under orders** uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Masters of the Arcane
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **^^Wizards^^** that are **under orders**.
**Designer's Note:** *Wizards in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.*

abilities.name: Throngs of the Faithful
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a **^^Fight^^** ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Sigmarite^^** units that target the enemy unit using that **^^Fight^^** ability.

abilities.name: Dawnbringer Crusade
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Have No Mercy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Aelf^^** units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: I've Seen Worse and Killed Better
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Duardin^^** units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Stentorian General
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

abilities.name: Beloved Leader
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

abilities.name: Grizzled Drillmaster
abilities.effect: Other visible friendly units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

abilities.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is **^^Human^^**, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is **^^Human^^**, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• If the target is **^^Duardin^^**, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• If the target is **^^Aelf^^**, add 3 to the target's control score.

abilities.name: Draw Steel!
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Human^^** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Astute Tactician
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Pious Veteran
abilities.effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a **^^Prayer^^** ability used by a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^**, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target

abilities.name: Bristling Attitude
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Spend any number of rage dice. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll **X** dice, where **X** is the number of rage dice spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.

abilities.name: Holy Aegis
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.

abilities.name: Benediction of the High Heavens
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

abilities.name: Reckoning of Sinners
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

abilities.name: Curse of Scorched Metal
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an **^^Attack^^** ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that **^^Attack^^** ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that **^^Attack^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: High Star's Light
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Speed of the Twin-tailed Comet
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cities of Sigmar Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-**^^War Machine Cities of Sigmar^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Prototype Arco-Combustor Uninhibitor
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic
• This unit can use **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Emergency Bellows
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Remove 1 of this unit's **heat tokens**.

abilities.name: Grapple-net Launcher
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Twin-tailed Comet of Honour
abilities.effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit's control score.

abilities.name: The Living City Cross
abilities.effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Aqshian Order of Merit
abilities.effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.
